title: build validate lists every file, by file name, and marks a file whose id an earlier file already has; with an id it adds the shadowed copies
source: intended: docs/decisions.md (build validate: a tolerant check of every build, one line per file, problem lines, one summary line)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-13, build validate, narrowed by the v0.1.0 cut). Files are listed by file name. A file whose id an earlier file already has is still checked and listed, with ` (shadowed by <layer> <display path>)` after its line; it is not the build of that id. The project here holds a second file, zz-haiku-explorer.yaml, with the id of haiku-explorer. With an id the command prints the winner first, then the files it shadows, and its summary counts the winner only.

stdout.regex:
(?m)^ok verifier repo jitso/builds/verifier\.yaml
ok haiku-explorer repo jitso/builds/zz-haiku-explorer\.yaml \(shadowed by repo jitso/builds/haiku-explorer\.yaml\)
checked 8 builds: 8 ok, 0 invalid$

(?m)^ok haiku-explorer repo jitso/builds/haiku-explorer\.yaml
ok haiku-explorer repo jitso/builds/zz-haiku-explorer\.yaml \(shadowed by repo jitso/builds/haiku-explorer\.yaml\)
checked 1 builds: 1 ok, 0 invalid$
